WITH selected AS (
  SELECT lead_id FROM leads
  WHERE status = 'new'::lead_status
  ORDER BY created_at ASC
  LIMIT {{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.count }}
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
)
UPDATE leads SET
  status = 'outreach'::lead_status,
  campaign_id = '{{ $('Webhook').first().json.body.campaignId }}'::uuid,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE lead_id IN (SELECT lead_id FROM selected)
RETURNING lead_id, email, company_name, city, current_url, campaign_id;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE outreach_sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS sent,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'new'::lead_status) AS reverted,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM leads
WHERE campaign_id = '{{ $('Parse Campaign Input').first().json.campaignId }}'::uuid;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE outreach_sent_at IS NOT NULL) AS sent,
  COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE outreach_sent_at IS NULL)     AS failed,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM leads
WHERE campaign_id = (
  SELECT campaign_id FROM campaigns
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
);
